messages:
Alex Park: FYI postmortem is up for the P95 latency spike earlier. Quick sync on owners/timeline?
Maya Singh: thanks. link to postmortem: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026-03-22-latency-spike
Jordan Lee: saw recurring KV cache miss pattern in the traces, might be cache churn during scale-down.
Tess Chen: agree. is the proposal to bump the KVCACHE TTL to 10m and re-run load test?
Alex Park: proposal included that + a canary that pins CPU/GPU packing to avoid batch size regressions.
Maya Singh: action list I suggest: 1) KVCACHE TTL change (owner Jordan, ETA 3d) 2) Dashboard panels for per-model p95/p99 and throttle rate (owner Tess, ETA 2d) 3) Canary deploy manifest + rollback hook (owner Alex, ETA 4d) 4) Run 24h sim load & errorbudget calc (owner Maya, ETA 5d)
Jordan Lee: added. I'll open PR for TTL change and include rollout plan with gradual increments.
Tess Chen: dashboard panel names/links: /dashboards/infra/latency-by-model and /dashboards/ops/errorbudget-burn - need editor rights for SLO tags.
oncall-bot: Incident 2026-03-22 lat-spike closed. Error budget usage: 12.3% burn over 7d window.
Maya Singh: we need to update SLO doc: reduce p95 SLO to 120ms for model-small, and set p99 target for model-big to 750ms, pending post-canonical tests.
Jordan Lee: question: does reducing p95 SLO need approval from product SLAs? cc @Tess
Tess Chen: product ok with temporary target changes for 2 weeks while we validate. I'll log change in SLO tracker spreadsheet.
Alex Park: can someone own timeline tracking in the postmortem? We should have weekly check-ins until all actions are closed.
Maya Singh: I'll own weekly check-ins. I'll add a recurring meeting, and post an update thread every Monday. Owner list assigned in the postmortem under 'remediation' section.
Jordan Lee: note: recurring incident pattern: pool eviction during nightly compactions. Action: coordinate with infra to stagger compactions. Owner: Jordan + infra (Alicia). ETA 6d.
Tess Chen: I've added dashboard alerts to fire when model p95 > 200ms for 5m and when errorbudget burn rate > 20% in 24h window.
Alex Park: thanks. Final ask: Alex will make a short runbook snippet for oncall to triage this pattern (commands, logs, where to look). ETA 2d.
deploy-bot: Deployment 2026-03-23T02:35 UTC created canary rollout for kvcache-ttl-pr-412 with 5% traffic.
Maya Singh: perfect. I'll monitor the SLO dashboard and update the thread with results. :eyes:
Alex Park: thanks everyone. We'll reconvene after the canary completes and weekly check-ins start next Monday. :thumbsup:
